name: Fang Hongbo
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2022); Forbes annual (2018-2025); Hurun Global (2018-2026); Hurun China (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Fang Hongbo is the chairman of China's Midea, one of the world's largest makers of home appliances.
Fang was born in a 10-family village in impoverished Anhui Province in central China.
He was hired by Midea in 1992 to edit the company newsletter.

name: Max Levchin
sec_insider_companies: Affirm Holdings, Inc. (AFRM) - Chief Executive Officer; COCA COLA CO (KO) - Director
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2021-2025); Hurun Global (2021-2026); SEC insider holdings (2026); Hurun Unicorn founders (2019-2020)
forbes_bio: Levchin is cofounder and CEO of Affirm Holdings, a fintech lending company that helps people pay for items like cameras and dresses in installments.
Before Affirm launched in 2014, Levchin cofounded PayPal, gaming company Slide and fertility-tracking app Glow.
Levchin owns more than 8% of Affirm, which went public on the Nasdaq in January 2021.
In 1991, Levchin and his family emigrated from Ukraine to Chicago as Jewish refugees; they arrived with just $700.

name: Henry Engelhardt
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2011-2025); Hurun Global (2017-2026); Sunday Times Rich List (2020)
forbes_bio: The son of a Chicago meatpacker, Henry Engelhardt aspired to be a journalist before turning to entrepreneurship.
His insurance company Admiral Group, founded in 1993, offers car and home insurance and created the UK's first insurance price comparison website.
Based in Cardiff, Wales, Admiral also has operations in Spain, France, Italy and the U.S.
Its American brands include Elephant Auto Insurance and Compare.com.
Engelhardt stepped down as CEO in May 2016, but he's still a part-time employee, mentoring senior managers and taking part in MBA recruitment.
forbes_facts: Admiral's Ministry of Fun organizes events for its employees, such as dress-up days, rock band contests, and surfing trips.
He and his wife, Diane, started Moondance Foundation to support causes in Wales, education, healthcare, poverty, and the arts.

name: Irfan Razack
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2024-2025); Hurun Global (2015-2026); Hurun India (2015-2019)
forbes_bio: Irfan Razack is the chairman and managing director of listed Bangalore real estate developer Prestige Estates Projects.
Prestige's portfolio includes 300 completed projects across residential, commercial, retail and hospitality segments.
Razack started out working in the family's textile and apparel retailing business before venturing into real estate.
Younger brothers Rezwan and Noaman, both billionaires, work with him.
Razack has a passion for adventure sports.

name: John Riccitiello
forbes_bio: John Riccitiello is the CEO of Unity Software, a San Francisco-based video game software development company.
Before joining Unity in 2014, he served as CEO of gaming giant Electronic Arts and launched private equity firm Elevation Partners.
Unity products have been used to make viral hits like the games Among Us, Pokemon Go and Overcooked.
Unity went public on the New York Stock Exchange in September 2020 at a $13.7 billion valuation.
In November 2021, the company announced its acquisition of major parts of Weta Digital, director Peter Jackson's visual-effects studio.

name: Wu Zhongyi
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2024); Forbes annual (2001-2025); Hurun Global (2020-2026); Hurun China (2017-2026)
forbes_bio: Wu Zhongyi is the vice chairman of Yealink Network Technology, a supplier of video conferencing solutions and Internet phones.
Yealink Chairman Chen Zhisong is also a member of the 2019 Forbes China Rich List.
Yealink is headquartered in the eastern Chinese city of Xiamen.

name: Zhao Tongtong
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2001-2023); Hurun Global (2021-2026); Hurun China (2020-2026)
forbes_bio: Zhao Tongtong is a co-founder of H World Group, the operator of one of the largest hotel chains in China.
Ji Qi, H World's other co-founder, is also a billionaire and chairs the company.
She's also a board member of China Education & Technology Group.
Zhao holds an MBA from McGill University.and M.S. degree from Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
H World shares trade on both the Nasdaq and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

name: Xu Wanmao
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2001-2025); Hurun Global (2018-2026); Hurun China (2001-2026)
forbes_bio: Xu Wanmao chairs the Huamao Group, whose interests include education, real estate and investment.
Huamao Group is headquartered in the eastern Chinese city of Ningbo, where it ranks as one of the city's largest service industry businesses.
Huamao Group's investments include the Bank of Ningbo.

name: Marcus Pürner
forbes_bio: Marcus Purner controls Pending System and a related group of German cycle parts companies that sell bicycles under the Cube brand.
The businesses combined entities have revenue of more than $4 billion.
Purner started Cube in 1993, when he was a student, operating the new operation out of his father's furniture factory in Waldershof, Germany.
